How TTMS powers Fuel Alerts

Detect abnormal fuel consumption, theft risk, and refill anomalies early. Protect operating margin while supporting safer routing and refueling behavior. This service emphasizes fuel transaction monitoring against route and distance context.

  • Fuel transaction monitoring against route and distance context
  • Anomaly alerts for unexpected drain, mismatch, or off-route fueling
  • Consumption trend analysis by truck, driver, and lane
  • Refuel policy checks tied to network and approved station rules
  • Dispatch notifications for rapid investigation and response
  • Cost reporting to support strategic fuel program decisions

Proactive Safety Response

Drivers get clearer fueling guidance and less last-minute pressure. Route-aware alerts reduce unsafe fuel-stop decisions.

  • Drivers get clearer fueling guidance and less last-minute pressure
  • Route-aware alerts reduce unsafe fuel-stop decisions
  • Operations can intervene quickly when suspicious events occur
  • Customers benefit from stable pricing and predictable execution

Fuel Alerts Audit & Compliance Reporting

Fuel Alerts data feeds TTMS reporting automatically so teams can plan fuel policies by lane, truck class, and risk profile and maintain audit-ready records.

  • Fuel Alerts events are captured with timestamps and operational context for cleaner audit trails.
  • ELD, AI DashCam, and GPS records support compliance reporting without fragmented manual collection.
  • Owners can review KPI, exception, and safety logs in one TTMS - Total Transport Management System workflow.
  • Teams generate regulator-ready and customer-facing reports with accurate, centralized data.
